messages:
lena (Growth): Quick ask: need a compact visual kit for our benchmark webinar. Deliverables: hero 1200x628, social 800x800, webinar canvas 1600x900, slide cover, and a 1-page microtile PDF. Three visual themes: latency-first, cost-first, hybrid. Two audience variants for microtiles: startup + enterprise. First draft Thurs AM, final by Fri. Omar can you take lead?

omar (Design): I can. Drop the key stats and 2 headline options + primary CTA and legal. Also confirm brand rules.

lena (Growth): CTA: "See benchmarks" primary; alt: "Try Redwood Inference". Legal tiny: "Results may vary; sample workloads." Bench numbers link: internal doc. Brand: Inter headings, no extra gradients, logo clearspace 24px.

tasha (Creative Ops): File outputs: layered Figma, PNG @2x, SVG icons, print-ready PDF for sales. Include alt text and simple export checklist.

ravi (PMM): Messaging snippets: latency: "Reduce tail latency up to 40%"; cost: "Lower inference spend by up to 3x"; hybrid: "Throughput + cost controls for predictable economics." Color cues: blue=latency, amber=cost, navy/green=hybrid. Include note: SLA tiers for Dedicated.

cesar (Sales): Need two microtile PDFs: enterprise (SLA + controls) and startup (quick start + pricing). Also a one-slide sales pack with 3 tiles.

omar (Design): I’ll produce 3 hero comps, 3 slide covers, 2 microtile sets, simplified diagram (client -> router -> cache/batch -> serving), social captions (3), and Figma template. Will post Figma link when ready.

figma-bot (Automation): Will run contrast scans on uploaded comps and flag failures.

lena (Growth): Accessibility: AA contrast for body; alt text + EN/US and EN/UK caption variants. Also a short 200-word design notes doc explaining usage.

omar (Design): Targeting Thurs AM review; final Friday. Posting Figma now when ready.

lena (Growth): Great — ping here with the link and screenshots. Thanks everyone :rocket:
